overview: A store hiring and training roster app for TLC: track roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation, training groups and certification, with leader cards, crews, gift bags and leader talks.
features: Track roadies from sign-up through paperwork, orientation, training and certification
Leader talks groups with a fill-from-not-yet-met helper
Roadie and leader collectible cards with a leader talk line
Crews, gift bags, check-ins and shift boards
